description:
Join us for the GitHub Universe 2026 opening keynote as we look at the next era of software, the developers building it, and the tools and workflows GitHub is creating to help them go further. Hear from engineering leaders April Leonard, Jay Parikh, Cassidy Williams, Burke Holland, and Damian Brady as they unveil major updates across GitHub Copilot, autonomous agent workflows, and core developer tools. Expect new announcements, live demos, and a few surprises along the way. 
 
Speakers: 

April Leonard, VP of Engineering for GitHub Copilot, GitHub 
Cassidy Williams, Sr. Director, Developer Advocacy, GitHub 
Burke Holland, Principal Cloud Advocate, Microsoft 
Jay Parikh, Executive Vice President, CoreAI, Microsoft 
Damian Brady, Staff Developer Advocate, GitHub 

Watch more videos from GitHub Universe 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MZfqId_rrB0&list=PLENrlACZ7mnU

title: Opening keynote: building the next era of software at GitHub Universe 2026

GitHub just released a mystery blind box keyboard where every kit includes a random colorway, enclosure, switch plate, and keycap set. Follow along as we assemble our very first DIY mechanical keyboard step-by-step using the official build guide. Find out which colorway we pulled from the box and how the custom switches feel right out of the packaging. Listen to the final sound test to hear how clean this mystery board sounds.

author: GitHub
description:
Cassidy Williams and GPS welcome GitHub VP of Developer Relations Martin Woodward to The GitHub Podcast to celebrate GitHub Universe. Martin explains why making pull requests easier has created an influx of low-effort AI contributions and how maintainer tools like pull request limits provide needed boundaries. He also gives a behind-the-scenes look at this year's hackable Universe badge, featuring an accelerometer, capacitive PCB gaming controls, and one-prompt MicroPython app deployments with Copilot. Catch full event sessions and technical deep dives at https://githubuniverse.com
